title: Reject invalid culture-read grace periods instead of hiding overdue reads
prompt:
Fix grace-period validation only in lib/ohworks-micro-culture-incubation.ts. Evidence: isReadOverdue at lines 122-126 multiplies gracePeriodHours without validation, then performs a comparison. I reproduced a read due January 1, checked January 10, with gracePeriodHours=NaN returning false. Infinity likewise suppresses an overdue result. These are valid JavaScript number values that bypass the TypeScript type. The demo maps this return value into each read's overdue flag at lib/ohworks-demo-crossmatch-culture-view.ts:100-105 and counts overdue reads, so invalid grace settings can hide overdue work.

Require gracePeriodHours to be a finite non-negative number before calculating the threshold. Reject invalid values with a deterministic, descriptive error instead of returning false. Reject multiplication overflow as well. Preserve zero and finite fractional grace periods and the documented strict boundary: exactly at dueAt plus grace is not overdue. Limit this job to grace validation; leave scheduling rules and timestamp parsing unchanged.

Add tests/ohworks/culture-grace-validation.test.ts covering NaN, both infinities, negative values, overflow, zero, fractional hours and exact-boundary behavior. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/culture-grace-validation.test.ts tests/ohworks/micro-culture-incubation.test.ts tests/ohworks/demo-crossmatch-culture-view.test.ts. The current evaluator suite passed and NaN suppression was reproduced during planning. Use only synthetic times. No credentials, deploys, sends, payments, migrations, workflows, package.json or auth changes. Keep the fix bounded and work on the assigned branch you are on.
